steps.caption: Posts & photos
steps.narration: This is Posts and Photos: Google updates and job photos for this roofing company, written, approved and scheduled here.

steps.caption: Choose a linked location
steps.narration: The page works on one location that is linked to its Google listing. Choose it under Location.

steps.caption: Photos and media library
steps.narration: Photos and media library shows the photos in the media library, ready to pick.

steps.caption: Tick the photos to publish
steps.narration: Tick the photos you want to publish.

steps.caption: Photo category
steps.narration: Photo category files it the way Google does: exterior, interior, at work, teams and more.

steps.caption: Compose a Google update
steps.narration: Compose a Google update is where an update, an event or an offer is written.

steps.value: Fall gutter clean-outs are booking now. Call to reserve a free inspection.
steps.caption: Write the update
steps.narration: Type the update, or start from an AI draft and edit it.

steps.caption: Call to action
steps.narration: Add a button under Call to action, like Call.

steps.caption: Schedule and approve
steps.narration: Under Schedule and approve, set the first publish time and the pace.

steps.caption: Approve & queue post
steps.narration: Nothing publishes until you choose Approve and queue post.

steps.caption: Calendar, queue & history
steps.narration: Calendar, queue and history lists every item, newest first.

steps.caption: Kind, time, status
steps.narration: Each item shows its kind, its time and its status.

steps.caption: Google Business → Posts & Photos
steps.narration: You'll find Posts and Photos in the Google Business rail on the left.

youtube.title: Posts & Photos for your Google Business Profile | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A tour of Posts & Photos in ConstructHUB: pick job photos from the media library, file them by Google photo category, write a Google update with a button, set the publish time and pace, and approve it. Calendar, queue and history lists every item with its status.
